snippet.title: Revolution Core at SAGE2026 Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for my fighting game, REVOLUTION CORE. Inspired by classic anime-style fighting games, Revolution Core is designed with freeform expression in mind. You can get the demo right now here:

https://gravethefenrir.itch.io/revolution-core
